definitions.explanation: A substance applied to skin or clothing to prevent insects, especially mosquitoes, from biting.

examples.japanese: {虫除|むしよ}けスプレーを{買|か}った。
{虫除|むしよ}けを{塗|ぬ}ってからキャンプに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I applied insect repellent before going camping.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{蚊|か}が{多|おお}いので、{虫除|むしよ}けが{必須|ひっす}だ。
examples.english: There are many mosquitoes in summer, so insect repellent is essential.

notes:
{虫除|むしよ}け protects against insect bites.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {虫除|むしよ}けスプレー (insect repellent spray)
- {虫除|むしよ}けシート (insect repellent wipes)
- {虫除|むしよ}けを{塗|ぬ}る (to apply insect repellent)

COMMON PRODUCTS:
- スプレー type (spray)
- ジェル type (gel)
- シート type (wipes)
- リング type (wearable rings)

RELATED TERMS:
- {蚊|か}: mosquito
- {蚊取|かと}り{線香|せんこう}: mosquito coil
- {虫刺|むしさ}され: insect bite
